The bactericidal activity of 3 cutaneous/mucosal antiseptic solutions is affected by the presence of interfering substances, such as blood, serum, or pus. The NF EN 13727 European Standard, which evaluates the efficacy of antiseptic solutions, may need to be improved to account for these interfering substances. 

To better reflect real-world conditions, the standard could be modified to include tests that assess the antiseptic solutions' effectiveness in the presence of these substances. This would provide a more accurate representation of the solutions' bactericidal activity in clinical settings, ultimately leading to better infection control and patient outcomes.
